description:
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter token with changeling.
Ayula and Bishop of Wings trigger.
Resolve Ayula's trigger, causing the Shapeshifter to fight any creature you don't control with power 2 or greater.
The Shapeshifter dies, triggering Bishop of Wings, creating a 1/1 Spirit token with all creature types.
Ayula and Bishop of Wings trigger.
Resolve Ayula's trigger, causing the Spirit to fight any creature you don't control with power 1 or greater.
The Shapeshifter dies, triggering Bishop of Wings, creating a 1/1 Spirit token with all creature types.
Repeat from step 5 until all creatures opponents control with 1 or more power have died.
Resolve all Bishop of Wings triggers, gaining 4 life for each creature that entered the battlefield during this combo.
